lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，巨石在我脚下！
鼻子一动，我朝味道走去。
lines.en: My nose twitches, and I walk toward the smell.
I don't wait for the sun to rise.

lines.zh: 我需要更多的巨人之眼！
独眼半眯着，巨脚踩过麦田。
lines.en: My single eye half-closed, my huge foot tramples the wheat.

lines.zh: 我把挡路的树连根拔起。
lines.en: I pull up the tree that blocks my way, roots and all.

lines.zh: 我是这片土地的守护者！
我低下独眼，正对着你的脸。
lines.en: I lower my single eye level with your face.
I want you to feed me.
My single eye is turning red.
My single eye has gone red; stop hitting.
Let the world see through your eye!
My eye can see through everything!

lines.zh: 食物在我眼中不过尘埃！
lines.en: Food is but dust in my eye!

lines.zh: 我的力量源于我的眼睛！
lines.en: My strength comes from my eye!

lines.zh: 眼睛变红了，你看见没有？
lines.en: My eye has gone red — did you see it?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你想象的更强大！
lines.en: My eye is stronger than you think!

lines.zh: 我这只眼睛看得你发毛。
lines.en: My one eye makes your skin crawl.
Your strength is useless against me!

lines.zh: 你的碰撞只能带来痛苦！
你的力量不足以对抗我！

lines.en: My single eye has gone red.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛需要你的陪伴！

lines.en: Stay with me, you won't be alone!
I choose you as my mate!
You are my partner for life!
Unite with me, create the future!

lines.zh: 滴答滴答，我可不轻易让人碰到。
lines.en: Tick tock, I don't give easily.
Here's a taste of my retaliation.

lines.zh: 血之石，我喜欢这种红宝石。
lines.en: Bloodstone, a red gem I like.

lines.zh: 巨人之眼碎片，我的战利品。

lines.en: Eat you, make the world quieter.
You can't escape, I'll get you.

lines.zh: 平原是我的家园，你来侵犯。
lines.en: Plains is my home, you invade.
My eye turned red, I'm angry.
You can't escape, I've targeted you.

lines.zh: 你隐藏不住，已经被发现了。
lines.en: You can't hide, I've found you.

lines.zh: 我会找到你，无论天涯海角。
lines.en: I'll find you, no matter where.

lines.zh: 我已经准备好了，等着吧。
你离我太近，我要攻击了。
红起来了，我的眼睛红起来了。
lines.en: It's turning red. My eye is turning red.
You have trampled my plains out of order.

lines.zh: 巨人之眼转过来，对准你。
lines.en: The giant's eye turns and fixes on you.

lines.zh: 我本来不想动手，你惹我了。
lines.en: I didn't want to fight. You made me.
I am hungry and angry. Perfect.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂着金锭，我看见了。
lines.en: There is gold on your belt. I saw it.

lines.zh: 我的眼神不会移开，你会被杀死。
lines.en: My gaze won't move, you'll be killed.
I lock you with my eye, don't move.

lines.zh: 我已经瞄准了，你的生命即将结束。
lines.en: I've targeted, your life ends now.

lines.zh: 我会把你变成碎片，别做梦。

lines.en: My targeting line, you can't escape.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛瞄准了，你无处可藏。
lines.en: My eye targets, nowhere to hide.
I'm targeting, don't try to run.

lines.zh: 我的视线锁定你，准备好。
lines.en: My sight locks you, get ready.
I'm staring at you, you can't move.

lines.zh: 我抬起拳头，影子罩住你。
lines.en: I raise my fist, and my shadow covers you.
Run. These plains have no end.
One of my steps is ten of yours.
My eye is fully red. You're finished.

lines.zh: 你躲到石头后面也没用。
lines.en: Hiding behind that rock won't help.
I pen you in with my feet.

lines.zh: 血之石的红色，和你很配。
lines.en: The red of bloodstone suits you.
I stare at you without blinking.
I'll use you to level this ground.

lines.zh: 你退到田边，我就跨过去。
lines.en: Back to the field's edge, and I step over it.

lines.zh: 这一拳把麦子压进土里。
lines.en: This punch drives the wheat into the soil.
I’ll eat you! — 独眼巨人, melee attack

lines.zh: 我抓起一块石头，正面砸下。
lines.en: I snatch up a rock and bring it down square.

lines.zh: 巨掌扫过，你连人带盾飞了。
lines.en: My huge palm sweeps, and you and your shield fly off.

lines.zh: 一拳下去，地面陷了个坑。
lines.en: One punch and the ground sinks into a pit.
Your shield breaks like dry hay.

lines.zh: 我拎起你的后领，扔向麦田。
lines.en: I grab your collar and hurl you into the wheat.

lines.zh: 我掰下一根树枝当棍子。
lines.en: I snap off a branch to use as a club.

lines.zh: 这一下，砸的是你的后背。
lines.en: This one lands on your back.

lines.zh: 我踩下去，你听见骨头响了吗？
lines.en: I stomp. Did you hear the bone crack?

lines.zh: 巨人的巴掌，盖住整张脸。
lines.en: A giant's palm covers your whole face.

lines.zh: 你飞出去，落在我的田里。
lines.en: You fly off and land in my field.
The eye is red, and my strength has grown.

lines.zh: 我一屁股坐下，你就没了。
lines.en: I sit down, and you are gone.
Don't play dead. I'm not done hitting.

lines.zh: 平原上，我先露一只眼睛。
lines.en: On the plains, my one eye appears first.

lines.zh: 麦子被踩倒，我走出来了。
lines.en: The wheat goes down, and I walk out.

lines.zh: 我从高处滑下去，摔疼了。
lines.en: I slid from a height and landed hard.

lines.zh: 水没到我的膝盖，我喘不上气。
lines.en: The water reaches my knees and I cannot breathe.
The blast rings in my ears and blurs my eye.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的肩膀，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder like a thorn.
I am so starved I would chew stone.

lines.zh: 闪电劈在我头顶，眼睛一亮。
lines.en: Lightning struck my head, and my eye flashed.

lines.zh: 我掉进了没有底的黑暗。
lines.en: I fell into a darkness with no bottom.
